title.zh: 数据变化下的分析交付

brief.zh: 财务使用者收到两版业务导出：金额单位从元变为分，记录状态也发生变化。分别复算每版有效记录与金额，说明差异来自哪里、哪些结果不能直接混算。
brief.en: The finance analyst receives two extracts with changed currency units and status rules. Reproduce both versions and explain which totals may be compared.

zh: 变更影响、复算证据和使用说明
en: a difference report and consumer instructions

zh: 旧/新口径结果各自可重现
所有差异能定位版本与输入
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Treating yuan as cents silently changes the monetary scale. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 新字段出现但旧查询静默输出旧指标，必须提示或拒绝误用
failure.en: Treating yuan as cents silently changes the monetary scale.

zh: 未解决问题及责任交接
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 财务使用者收到两版业务导出：金额单位从元变为分，记录状态也发生变化。分别复算每版有效记录与金额，说明差异来自哪里、哪些结果不能直接混算。
新字段出现但旧查询静默输出旧指标，必须提示或拒绝误用；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: The finance analyst receives two extracts with changed currency units and status rules.
Reproduce this failure first: Treating yuan as cents silently changes the monetary scale.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
